args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for money rounding per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding but round_money was
using ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented (and expected by tests) to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match FIN-212.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Fixes the nightly build failure.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
